newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate down, baht weaker late.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate down, baht weaker late.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate was down further to 7.00 percent in late trade on Thursday from 8.00 in early morning amid extremely high market liquidity, dealers said.
Dealers said the government budget disbursement for the new fiscal period which began Oct 1 and some money coming into the system from sales of the stocks had caused excess liquidity in the system.
"There were some local banks offering the interbank rate at below 7.00 percent. Money from the stock market was still in the market," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
The baht was lower to 25.450-25.255 to the dollar late from 25.25.435-25.440 in early morning on heavy dollar buying triggered by excess money supply, dealers said.
The one-month dollar/baht swap premium was at 8.00/9.00 satangs per dollar late compared with 7.50/8.50 in early morning.
The mid-rate was fixed at 25.43 to the dollar against 25.44 on Wednesday.
